description:
Free Windows utility for code signing and signature verification.

Free Code Signer is a free Windows desktop utility for digitally signing files and verifying signatures. It supports Microsoft SignTool and the Windows Certificate Store, YubiKey/PIV, smart cards, HSM/PKCS#11 workflows, Azure Artifact Signing, Google Cloud KMS, Jsign and Java JAR signing. Features include batch signing, timestamping, certificate inspection, signature verification, reports and 25 interface languages.
Free Code Signer v1.7.1 adds a Windows x64 installer, improved certificate inspection, better YubiKey/PIV/HSM handling, crash diagnostics and improved stability for large signing batches. This release also includes localization updates for all 25 interface languages.
